See this email fully formatted/linked as drafted [here](https://coda.io/d/Math4Wisdom_d0SvdI3KSto/Email-writing_suth2#Email-writing-table_tu-5m/r1&view=modal):

---

Hello Andrius and All. 

Thank you for this kind and generous welcome. 

“*Daniel, if I understood correctly, looks at our Math 4 Wisdom community as a success story, based on what we have already achieved.  And furthermore he is ready to make his investigatory home with us - or his nest, in the language of ant colonies.  We will see how this unfolds but Daniel, I appreciate this opportunity to work with you.*” 

To encounter even one language expression or larger work of truth-oriented quality that is resonant through time and across minds, is a success story for me. So, through the dedicated epistemic and inclusive foraging of Kirby and others, to come to a “clean, well-lighted place” with the kinds of wisdom and discussion here, is special and I am excited/appreciative for the epistemic, delightful, serious, formal/informal multi-journeys to come (and on the nest metaphor, there is a [2017 paper](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC5310590/) on plurality of senses/aspects of multi-nesting in ants “*Inferring polydomy: a review of functional, spatial and genetic methods for identifying colony boundaries*”).

As for where I am beginning here, in terms of curiosities, interests, and participation:

- I first plan to learn and understand, what discourse, topics, relationships are already here. I have listened to some [videos](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suX5O9za#_luSvFBsC), [email archives](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suCwO2Pw#_lujpJ4OR), and [Wiki](https://www.math4wisdom.com/wiki/Exposition/Introduction) pages, however not all. 

- The Knowledge Engineering Wiki page is updated, and will be point of reference for the project [https://www.math4wisdom.com/wiki/KnowledgeEngineering/Welcome](https://www.math4wisdom.com/wiki/KnowledgeEngineering/Welcome) (some links will take you to a Commentable [and edit-requestable] [Coda document](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suV-LOe1#_lu5cTC_R)).  

- On the Knowledge Engineering wavelength: however it is relevant for Andrius and you all — I look to augment the availability, visibility, and relevance for the individual and shared corpuses co-created and alluded to here. I am engaged in this kind of archival/curatorial work at the [ISSS (Int. Soc. Systems Science)](https://www.math4wisdom.com/wiki/KnowledgeEngineering/Welcome) and with others, mostly though at [Active Inference Institute](https://www.activeinference.org/) in my regular work. 

- On the Math/Wisdom/Language wavelength: I am short- and long-term curious to understand various “mature but different thinkers” (as Andrius mentioned on other thread). I have so many other comments/etc to make on all the amazing writings in the email haha, so first over the coming weeks I intend to understand what is helpful here & what is aligned/streamlined for me. I will look forward to our meetings beginning this coming week, to get things going on all these explorations. 

- Information on [synchronous meetings](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_su0opxmi#_luoSFaOe), starting this week at [this Zoom link](https://zoom.activeinference.org/): 

  - [Tuesday 15 UTC meeting ~ Language of Wisdom meeting](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/event?action=TEMPLATE&tmeid=MWZubDNrMXNjbHA0ZnRicjk3N2pmdDlmYTdfMjAyNDAyMjBUMTUwMDAwWiBkYW5pZWxhcmlmcmllZG1hbkBt&tmsrc=danielarifriedman%40gmail.com&scp=ALL)

  - [Wednesday 15 UTC meeting ~ Knowledge Engineering meeting](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/event?action=TEMPLATE&tmeid=Nm5odHRyY3ZxbzJmdTRqODR0Nzc2bGpsbjVfMjAyNDAyMjFUMTUwMDAwWiBkYW5pZWxhcmlmcmllZG1hbkBt&tmsrc=danielarifriedman%40gmail.com&scp=ALL)

  - I have added some of you to the calendar events. Let me know by reply if you want to be added to them directly/again. 

Small correction on “He mentioned MathStream  [https://www.carnegielearning.com/solutions/math/mathstream/](https://www.carnegielearning.com/solutions/math/mathstream/)”, the MathStream I was referencing was the [series we host at AII](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLNm0u2n1IwdotiF0nt68MlY0m8o2HNlfX). 

I hope this sets us up somewhat for the week and weeks to come. Leave a comment in the Coda or email here with any questions.

Thank you & Peace, 

Daniel

Sounds good for all the emails written in the last few days. 

Many great points to pick up on in the coming meetings (people can always add/comment on agenda items [here](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_su0opxmi#_lu7Nn9ru): [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_su0opxmi#_lu7Nn9ru](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_su0opxmi#_lu7Nn9ru)). 

I really like the comments about namespaces, and theoretical/applied comparability in multi-perspectival (eco)systems. 

“*For example (?), the linking of OODA Loop to your SFR (stand, follow-through, reflect) trisom.* ” — yes this is awesome. There is a lot to go into here, to add a few things here: In 2021 we connected the OODA 4-stage sequential model, to the Active Inference 4-fold partition [https://zenodo.org/record/5759807](https://zenodo.org/record/5759807) . And this question of “How particular is the physics of the free energy principle?” [https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC8902446/](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC8902446/) is a classic one.  
What topologies of the (agent-environment) interface (= action-perception, boundary) have what kinds of formal and empirical properties? e.g. considered as monad, dyad, tryptic, tetrahedra, 5 or other or higher etc.  
How particular (e.g. specific in “fully synthetic” formulation [https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.14145](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.14145) ) are the axioms and implications of the Free Energy Principle? e.g. in the classical formulation of [https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.12996](https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.12996) or quantum of [https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.15242](https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.15242) . 

“*Must one of these models be the absolutely true one, based on empirical evidence?  The OODA loop guy was a fighter pilot and he's privately referencing his own abilities, whereas Andrius has a different background.*” — “**Boyd: The Fighter Pilot Who Changed the Art of War**” is a biography of John Boyd that was informative and engaging. He was advanced and far-seeing in his conceptualizations of information, matter, energy, physics, and also unique/frustrated in his approach. 

“*I'm inclined to replace "taking a stand" with "assuming a posture" which may or may not be one of standing.*” — this also came up in the Mental Gravity livestream, about stance and center of gravity. In walking insects (ant nestmates), the verticality axis is differently coupled to (lateral) responsivity and ability to move. Whereas in mammals and humans with upright bipedalism, there is complex and dynamic homeo/allostatic regulation of center of gravity, both physically in terms of mass, and cognitively in terms of the gravitational interpretation of Bayesian Mechanics. 

“*One might be hitting a peak (high) in awareness of one type, while losing all awareness of these other phenomena.*” — Yes. Lachlan seemed to link together empirical work, suggesting that the experience of the realtime moment (attentional salience/relevance) is on a relatively strict/zero-sum tradeoff with the experience of narrative self (default mode network). Also there are attentional tradeoffs among senses, and probably many other patterns like that too. 

“*Awareness is always dawning.*” — Perhaps here, even “always already” (term used by Heidegger, Agamben, and many others). 

“*how might my experience with math4wisdom rub off in such a way that [Kirby] might be truthfully labeled "a mathematician" e.g. by ChatGPT, which currently does so? [1]....The project again:  how to make ChatGPT not a liar, when it claims I'm a mathematician, by means of some M4W magic?*” — There are several possible approaches for such semAntic MathMagic. One approach is to include in model training and/or search scope, resources which support the easy/likely semantic connections between Kirby Urner and doing math (e.g. educational, research, ethnographic, computational, Synergetics, collaborative, M4W, aspects). What is today two hops away: [https://www.perplexity.ai/search/Is-Kirby-Urner-HRYuuqJQSXu7V09BuGpvYw](https://www.perplexity.ai/search/Is-Kirby-Urner-HRYuuqJQSXu7V09BuGpvYw) could soon be one or none. 

See you later & Peace,

Daniel

I am picking up on the emails & catching up on everything since last Wednesday’s meeting.

[Andrius email 6 Mar 2024](https://www.freelists.org/post/math4wisdom/Data-flow-for-building-tables-of-conceptual-frameworks,2)  
— You are right about Coda still not having that kind of “last edited” feed, unless one sets that up as like a “last edited” auto-column in a table. Definitely that is a nice feature for the Wiki.  
— Thank you for adding those drafted questions of mine to the front page. I am looking forward to refining, developing, and collaborating on those questions and more.  
— [Ant Colony Epistemology](https://www.math4wisdom.com/wiki/KnowledgeEngineering/AntColonyEpistemology) is great. One nice paper on this topic in 2017 is “[Individual versus collective cognition in social insects](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28057830/)” which clarifies there are continua/interactions among cognitive processes at the nestmate level (e.g. step-counting), whole-colony level (e.g. nest relocation), and interactions with the extended niche. Also more on the philosophy side, an early paper of Deborah Gordon in 1992 is “Wittgenstein and ant-watching” ([journal](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/BF00130161), [PDF](https://web.stanford.edu/~dmgordon/old2/Gordon1992Wittgenstein.pdf)). I discussed this paper + Synergetics at [this time stamp](https://www.youtube.com/live/N_35T4pmjZM?feature=shared&t=418) in a stream a few years ago. Personally I am very excited to revisit/resurface some of these links in new contexts today.  
— [Framework Tables](https://www.math4wisdom.com/wiki/Exposition/FrameworkTables). I will think more about what these examples and counterexamples mean. A summarizing/question arising for me are like, “*Is the candidate framework a posited categorical (fixed low-integer discrete articulate schema) heuristic/articulation/classification approach for a given scope?*” = YES for e.g. “icon, index, symbol” in the Semiotic context or OODA in the Action context, hence those are frameworks, whereas = NO for e.g. taxonomic classifications, historical epochs, periodic tables, horoscopes, lifecycle stages.  
  
[Kirby email 6 Mar 2024](https://www.freelists.org/post/math4wisdom/Data-flow-for-building-tables-of-conceptual-frameworks,1)  
— Awesome Kirby, thank you for your multifarious stigmergy. 

[Jere email 7 Mar 2024](https://www.freelists.org/post/math4wisdom/March-5-steering-committee-notes-etc)  
— Thank you for the insightful and also funny message. 

[Andrius email 9 Mar 2024](https://www.freelists.org/post/math4wisdom/Data-flow-for-building-tables-of-conceptual-frameworks,5)  
— This is a key and helpful email (at least in what I have read so). 

As for meetings this week:  
— On [March 12](https://coda.io/d/Math4Wisdom_d0SvdI3KSto/Meetings_suxmi#Meetings_tuvz5/r8&view=full), I brought some quotes of what Jere and Kirby want to discuss, and added some color/commentary.  
— On [March 13](https://coda.io/d/Math4Wisdom_d0SvdI3KSto/Meetings_suxmi#Meetings_tuvz5/r9&view=modal) for Knowledge Engineering, among other topics I added some explorations involving uploading [Synergetics to PerplexityAI](https://www.perplexity.ai/search/Comprehensively-summarize-and-Yh1g_6LhRUmgOySgqcYGcw), and using Claude 3 Opus (new language model released with large context window) to ask some questions & operationalize concepts. Also Yes I have watched the David Koski Feb 2024 Trimtab video now, there is a lot to think about haha. Great meeting there & also many things to bring in from Quadray thread. 

See you all later & Peace,

Daniel

Hello all, 

I will try to provide some notes and links reflecting upon recent discussions. I hope these writings can be taken lightly & curiously, as I probably wildly under- and over-provide communications, sampling and foraging across Pareto frontiers. Feel free to view the message on [Coda itself, to add & comment directly](https://coda.io/d/Math4Wisdom_d0SvdI3KSto/Email-writing_suth2#Email-writing-table_tu-5m/r4&view=modal). 

Tyler, thank you for the [introduction email](https://www.freelists.org/post/math4wisdom/Greetings,504) and joining our recent meeting.

Kirby’s writing always help connect dots for (the inner high schooler in) me, leaving me laughing and learning. The [Recap](https://www.freelists.org/post/math4wisdom/recap-of-recent-studies-in-our-space), [4-17](https://www.freelists.org/post/math4wisdom/Math-4-Wisdom-PostEclipse-Springtime,1), and [Coda Catacombs](https://controlroom.blogspot.com/2024/04/catacombs.html) writings are delightful. There are reels and outtake reels of comedy and inspiration to be drawn (on) from here.

Ryan B, from your [email on 4-11](https://www.freelists.org/post/math4wisdom/How-does-contact-geometry-happen-in-the-brain), those are some interesting connections/contacts. I am left considering the question “*Can, in general, x-somes be reduced to x-k-sums?*” and I want to continue investigating this with the answers I already have (1st mind), questions I already have (2nd mind), and leaving openness for what else could be (here I believe that in the openness there could be new tools and memes delivered to 1st and 2nd mind, AND that would reduce uncertainty on the nature/function of the 3rd mind).  

To the email of Andrius [from 4-14](https://www.freelists.org/post/math4wisdom/April-24-Wednesday-Evolution-in-Biology-and-Physics-and,1), I am very excited for the upcoming discussion on Biology with John Harland (some relevant notes and background on him are [M4W wiki as well](https://www.math4wisdom.com/wiki/Research/JohnHarland)). I have developed several directions and reflections on the [Biology Coda page](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suxYHdB8#_luCob9O9). One special note here, might be to juxtapose Ryan’s 4-11 question about reduction of x-somes, with Andrius’ comment about minds as adding. Where is Biology, Evolution, and Change in all this? Where/How/Why are we seeing types of expansions and reductions across scales of biological systems? On that Biology page I also wrote some further initial forays about how this could connect to some of our analytical work in modeling multiscale biological systems, entomological and otherwise. 

In terms of the post-eclipse [email of 4-18](https://www.freelists.org/post/math4wisdom/Math-4-Wisdom-PostEclipse-Springtime); thank you Andrius. It was an email that echos the beautiful, tempestuous, and volatile springtime here in Davis. “*Math 4 Wisdom is a language club for learning Wondrous Wisdom*”. Maybe one day there (w/c)ould be some linguistics-type textbooks, categorizing and analogizing to formal grammars and parsers for symbolic languages. And yet even total familiarity with such linguistics, the shapes on the page, would be non-equivalent to practicing the language. The ordering of textbook chapters is not the ordering or composition of childhood experiences that lead up to fluency, use, refinement, and innovation. Of course this is common ideation expressed in different ways, the ideas are possibly quite obvious & how I stated it was possibly irrelevant to you the reader —  and what else could be expected from the constrained generation of authentic finite speech?

“*What we seemed cold and dark, sad and lonely, today seems bright and sunny, warm and friendly.*” — All I can say to this is; What initially seemed to be a simple sentence with extraneous possibly-extraneous second word, upon partially-observed reflections and stands and follow-throughs, came to be differently understood within a (2:2::2:2) adjectival pattern (cold:dark::sad:lonely:::bright:sunny::warm:friendly), immediately blooming symmetries that pop off of the written line into a space which is something like that which is orthogonal to that which is orthogonal, as felt in review.

As to your [4-18 email Andrius](https://www.freelists.org/post/math4wisdom/Making-sense-of-what-to-do-with-ourselves,1), about the pre-submission inquiry, wow. There are ways to publish papers with no gatekeeping like [Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/) however I know that is not fully the point. There is so much here to add on the [Urizen-like](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Urizen) character of academic discourse and publishing. Though I didn’t have such words back then (14 years ago now, beginning my journey in academic Entomology), I thought that relentless integrity and interactive participation, defined the kind of academic ecosystem we strived for. I see this as more than just one anecdotal loss (of a journal to publish a paper). It is an emblematic event portending their/our/the failure to gain in academic research, and more broadly failure to include, uphold, and succeed. 

Combining quotes from a few emails linked, “*I am trying to communicate that Math 4 Wisdom is all about being investigators within an investigatory community*” and “*Even a simple project allows me to think who might be interested and engage them”* — I see multiple layers in this. There is the sheer aspect of activity (e.g. any momentum in something to work with, and a better starting position than cold). Additionally there is something here I believe specifically related to the nested/nestable structure of Inquiry, in the sense/tradition of Pragmatism and Operationalism. We’re (talking about) interacting on a dancefloor, not sidelined at some other game to be played. I wrote some more thoughts and questions on how I am processing that, and juxtaposed with my relationship with truth, as a [multiscale investigator here](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_sujjvM3E#_lu_MkOnW).

Thank you all for the threads & glimmers.  
I admire the shared tenacity & aim to leave the niche, and the minds of nestmates, better than when I found it/them.  
Of course it couldn’t be known on the micro- or macro- whether a given contribution would be aligned on that mission. However the only way to find out is to actively infer, Standing-Reflecting-FollowingThrough. The only losing move is not to play (not to play is at very least to have lost out on the affordance of play itself, to say nothing of all that follows a play).

Daniel

Hello all, 

Standing by and Following through on some Reflections over the past few weeks.  
This email can be read fully-formatted in Coda [here](https://coda.io/d/Math4Wisdom_d0SvdI3KSto/Email-writing_suth2#Email-writing-table_tu-5m/r7&view=modal) (as per usual, the genre here is: lossy allusive finite linearized snapshot re-presented haphazardly).

Two main parts to this message: 1) reviewing emails from May, and 2) updates from Knowledge Math with Andrius, and connections with other/broader inquiries. 

1. Reviewing Math4Wisdom emails. 

- I appreciated Andrius’s “Give our Math 4 Wisdom ecosystem a problem to solve!” message on [May 3rd](https://www.freelists.org/post/math4wisdom/Give-our-Math-4-Wisdom-ecosystem-a-problem-to-solve). Do April showers bring May flowers? I find myself continually returning to this idea that the M4W work is in the ecology of interactions and nestings of investigations (e.g. the language speaking/using/learning which activates us as part of the “four levels” of “deliberate investigation”, not just the talking-about which subtly bystands us even amidst motor and mental activity). The central provocation here was “*Give the ecosystem a problem to solve*”, which relates micro-cosmically to us here & now in M4W, as well as more generally to agent-niche interaction (as explored in the [4/22/24 discussion with John Harland](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suxYHdB8#_lu3fJ2Qc), and informed by Jere’s deep aesthetic understanding/grasp of biology). The email also provides rich avenues related to the Econet concept in theory and practice; some of these avenues were developed and amended in following emails and surely ongoing discussions. 

- To the [Investigation of Ryan Buchanan on May 4](https://www.freelists.org/post/math4wisdom/Investigation,16) (”May the Fourth”), this was great and fundamental. I have also enjoyed learning about Mike Levin’s work on time cones or diamonds (cone-like if we think of the present as a bottleneck expanding into the pasts/futures, and diamond-like if we consider a thick present tapering into thin pasts/futures). Ryan asks "Where do I end, and the rest begins?" and here many successive layers of interrogation are possible, for example visualized in the [Figure 2 of Levin 2019](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/psychology/articles/10.3389/fpsyg.2019.02688/full) of nested systems such as the ant colony. How does the actuality & actual self-understanding of the asker, conditionalize or initialize the question about where one (that one or another) begins and ends? About “*how can I make this rigorous?*” in reference to the Museum model, here are some notes & resources on the work of [Moggi on Collection Monads](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suli3zvK#_lu5LD3lI). This appears to be a promising phrasing for “Categories that are suitable for databases”, so that could apply to archival/curatorial resources such as (databases of) museums. For me, the category theoretic method as applied to databases/collections, relates to broader questions such as, How can we have high-integrity information infrastructures?

- In [Ryan Alonge’s May 5 email](https://www.freelists.org/post/math4wisdom/Thoughts-on-EMotion), there were many interesting points about emotions. He closes with “*I am interested in your thoughts on the relevance of emotions within your work and how they may play a role in how others can begin to understand consciousness. Do you think this is a conversation worth having in order to help others "bridge" the gap towards a new way of thinking?*”. This is interesting to consider, and the question of bridging/jumping across gaps, is a recurrent and notable theme.

- Jere, thank you for bringing so many active elements into the discussion. We are rapidly seeing updating and learning in progress, as e.g. the home license idea was proposed (taking a stand), followed through upon, and reflected on. I will be watching [https://www.e-c-o.net/wiki/](https://www.e-c-o.net/wiki/) and looking forward to how it develops. Most recently on [May 12th “econet and stuff”](https://www.freelists.org/post/math4wisdom/econet-and-stuff) I resonated with “we should set up the e-c-o.net as an independent participatory  
community dedicated to resolving environmental and social problems. Note that this would be a participatory community as opposed to an investigatory community such as Math 4 Wisdom” — I am curious about the similarities/differences with participation and investigation, e.g. are these attributes of engagement like a Venn diagram, like axes in space, or what? Also I enjoyed the “Goldilocks Maximum Entropy Principle”, which came back into play with some of our ongoing work on Epistemic value & Information foraging, noted below. 



2. Knowledge Math, Knowledge Engineering, and Active Inference.  

- Now coming to several ongoing areas of my personal work & collaborations with Math4Wisdom ecosystem. 

- Andrius and I are meeting on Tuesdays, in Knowledge Math. Our notes (hastily scribbled) from today are centered [here](https://coda.io/d/Math4Wisdom_d0SvdI3KSto/Meetings_suxmi#Meetings_tuvz5/r24&view=modal) (follow links to see more notes; date-specific note pages are more like the main trunk rather than total repository). I will try to reflect again and summarize here. There were many excellent directions. First we covered some of Andrius’s developments in Bott periodicity. Next we covered ecosystem updates, for example the collaboration with Jere, and the new [501(c)(3) status of the Active Inference Institute](https://activeinferenceinstitute.substack.com/p/the-institute-is-now-501c3). We considered Ryan’s Museum model in light of the category theoretic monadic treatment of databases. From there/then we went in two main directions, first about Active Inference & secondly about inquiry and wisdom more generally.  

  - On Active Inference: 

    - One project I am working on over the next two weeks, is the preparation of background material for the paper [Active Data Selection and Information Seeking](https://www.mdpi.com/1999-4893/17/3/118), in advance of several livestream discussions with the authors at end of May. There is so much to say about this paper. Some of the big questions driving my interest in this paper are, How is Information Seeking modeled/approached using Active Inference and other methods? How can we think about the setting of (epistemic) foraging holistically/generally, respecting and encompassing its varied challenges?

    - In discussion with Andrius, we made and noted many connections between the analytical representations of policy selection in Active Inference, and the operativity of the 3 minds (unconscious, conscious, consciousness). Mnemonically, pragmatic value is associated with unconscious preferences and reflexivity (1st mind), epistemic value is associated with the curiosity and questioning of the conscious (2nd mind), and the modulation/tradeoff/balance between 1st and 2nd mind by the consciousness (3rd mind) is linked to the Free Energy functional (e.g. Expected Free Energy = Pragmatic + Epistemic, as in [Equation 2.6 of 2022 textbook](https://coda.io/d/ActInf-Textbook-Group_d4CkUI-iA_K/Equations_suXgC#Textbook-Equations-table_tuKLm/r79)). We explored a nested policy selection setting, where the 3-cycle decision of which book to read, was nested within a slower 3-cycle of which library to go to, that day. This kind of investigation of multiscale inquiry itself, feels naturally linked to the formalism and tradition of Active Inference, and also provides fruitful contact points for co-learning about Wonderous Wisdom.

    - The paper makes explicit comparison about how the full information gain epistemic imperative, goes beyond Maximum entropy sampling (alluded to above regarding Jere’s Goldilocks MaxEnt). In the situation where latent states have homogenous variability, then MaxEnt sampling of sensory variability is a statistically optimal strategy. However in situations with heterogeneous latent variability profiles (this is a more relaxed and realistic consideration), it can be shown how the Active Inference epistemic imperative outperforms baseline MaxEnt (see paper Section 4, or [here](https://coda.io/d/Active-Data-Selection-Livestream-057-2024_dxVMX0mCzBJ/0_sul87#0-sections_tu51K/r7&view=modal)). Speculatively, the aesthetic sensibility is part of the deeper generative model of the active observer, which enriches the primary MaxEnt sampling with Goldilocks-ness. I would be remiss not to mention here the 1982 children’s book by Bucky Fuller, “*Tetrascroll: Goldilocks and the Three Bears, A Cosmic Fairy Tale*” — where the 3 external happenings (star-events) are tetrahedrally coordinated with the observer Goldilocks (thusly constituting a cognitive tetrahedron; the minimal 4-fold system/partition). 

  - On inquiry and wisdom more broadly, there is much to say stemming from (leading up to) today. 

    - A key observation was that even for individuals and organizations who recognize the relevance of knowledge (e.g. variously: belief, representation, information) management and engineering, “Wisdom” is somewhere between ill-defined and taboo. Why is this so & how can we investigate amidst this Knowledge-Wisdom differential? 

    - In my personal collaboration with Andrius, definitely there is a meeting/convergence, where we could say I am coming from the Knowledge side and he is coming from the Wisdom side, and we are finding and co-creating Maths as boundary/blanket/interface. Hence the iterative refinement of our thinkings and manifest digital niche. So there we were today, Math-hiking in and around the “Grand Canyon” between Knowledge and Wisdom. What is the difference and gap between the two? When and where is this a gap to respect/appreciate, to bridge (e.g. with an external infrastructure project), or to jump (e.g. with a leap [of faith] or few)?

Daniel

**This email can be read in Coda here:** 

---

0. 

Thank you  for this email. 

I am glad to see the earnest, open, authentic participation of many in M4W! With your scaffold and impetus as always. 

There is a lot to respond to & share a bit about what I am up to. This will be a two-part email; in the first part I will respond to the Culinary metaphor from your email, in the second part I will give preliminary response to your questions. 

---

1. 

You write “*Apparently, that [capacity to care] tuning fork can be broken, which is to say, it functions as a physical sense organ, like our sense of balance, or like a flavor.*”

Expanding within this Cognitive-Flavor mapping within the [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_sugFmpP_](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_sugFmpP_)  / [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_su618O5l](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_su618O5l)  setting, here is some of my manual and experienced relation with that — consider these writings like pulling a few ladles from my soup containing (unified) multitudes. 

“*Qualitatively, I think it is a single flavor. Either I care or I don't..... If I care, then I care*” — are statements related to the “zeroth mind”, the level of actual reality, the fact of the matter of embodiment, the primary level of actual “it is what it is”, the “it” from which questions like “whether/what/how/why I see it” make sense, as we discussed [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T05uLRbcloE). There is a qualitative “taste or not” (related to what is spotlit or not for an entity). The salt in the shaker is not tasting salty (it is unexperienced, it is not lit in anyone’s theater). This is the space of phenomenology, Dasein, haecceity, intra-activity, etc.

Going a bit more into my personal culinary style and approach to the field....

in the Cognitive (Meta-)Scientific settings I associate with (American) Pragmatism. Experience is in the “[synthesis of agent and niche](https://zenodo.org/records/17243488)“, “unity is plural and at minimum two”. Within that American tradition, [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suRfidAo](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suRfidAo) is an operational federated art, craft, and science of [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_sujjvM3E](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_sujjvM3E) — I go out (and return to) that primary existence of TASTE (my firsthand experienced, and virtually-imagined [as experienced]), and when “out” apply [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suQWY5DS](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suQWY5DS) and [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suo0BIkP](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suo0BIkP) (I don’t expect these frameworks to do anything for me, they are [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_subpHvLx](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_subpHvLx) I seek to use in service). 

Relatively I have a voracious appetite overall (though also have no problem with intermittent fasting), and appreciate a relevant blend of savory and sweet in the context of a balanced information diet (don’t get me started on the micronutrients here!). I like various dishes, and respect culinary traditions/practices outside of what I eat. Within each person’s constraints, preference, and context, it is important to try to balance different options for food, not just in principle but in practice. *Healthy, Tasty, and Generous!* — That’s my wish for each ([see page 4](https://zenodo.org/records/16740439)). And I pair that wish with [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suhVOaG1](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suhVOaG1): “I was walking among the fires of Hell, delighted with the enjoyments of Genius; which to Angels look like torment and insanity”, and "One law for the lion and the ox is oppression”. 

Pragmatic value, the Known, the first mind, is like savory.  
Epistemic value, the Unknown, the second mind, is like sweet.  
Adaptive (persistent, coherent, resonant, ...) interaction of Agent-Niche appears (to that Agent or the Niche) as the intelligent modulation of savory and sweet, the thirdness (content of the taste) always already with fourness (awareness). That blended thirdness of experience (redness, saltiness, sweetness, [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suNQr93F](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suNQr93F)) arrives/co-arises with awareness like a letter arising within envelope (McLuhan; Media is the Message).

A spoonful of sugar makes the medicine go down, and I at times enjoy baking and eating sweet delights.  
Meanwhile I understand that I can live on savory alone (fat and protein = keto), but not sweet alone (rabbit starvation). I [do/can] not live in uncertainty and unknowing alone (Deuteronomy 8:3, Matthew 4:4). There are a lot of funny ways to branch from here, such as high-protein bread, sweet amino acids, regional agro-economics), suffice to say that this writing consists of strongly-held transient experiences, without excessive secondary re-writing (meaning e.g. that metaphors ought to be considered allusive, and structural layout to be sketched not laminated).

So while I visit the third mind mode (in a discreet switching metaphor of [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suRqOPnN](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suRqOPnN)), or have the third mind in the 1-2 mix (in a mixture model metaphor) — in my quest I am motivated and active in all my minds. I recognize that for Wondrous Wisdom, and Math4Wisdom as a culture of investigatorship, it makes sense to emphasize the second, and third minds. Focusing on “what [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_su9mLmih](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_su9mLmih) we are asking” helps keep that 2nd mind space open (and in training), preventing collapse to the 1st mind, and opening up the possibility of “*thinking fresh with the investigating mind*”). I draw inspiration and learnings from this cultural emphasis, while recognizing that my personal journey has two feet in each of those three minds (and the 2 antennae open into that divine fourth 🐜 [Salt, Fat, Acid AND Heat]).  

Being able to practice hierarchical [cognitive modeling as an art and a science](https://zenodo.org/records/16740439) — allows me to make what is sweet on one level, savory on another. In that situation, it can be as simple as: a pragmatic value at higher level, correlating/mapping with epistemic value at lower level (”I prefer to learn”). Also it is possible to nest other combinations for other functions, giving open-ended functionality at the “[Triple equivalence for the emergence of biological intelligence](https://www.nature.com/articles/s42005-025-02059-4)“ of Neural Network, Bayes Graph, Turing Machine ([discussed here](https://www.youtube.com/live/gS_WocoCJvI)) considered within [multiscale unfolding](https://www.mdpi.com/1099-4300/25/7/964).  

“*Another dimension of caring is in terms of three stages: where it comes from, where it goes to, and where it is in between.*” — Agreed with this, which I also interpret within a Linguistic Case system ([CEREBRUM](https://zenodo.org/records/15231156)). So I see this kind of structured assertion, in terms of a “(sub)language of caring” where Andrius proposes a 3-case stance (from, to, between). He and others can have perspectival evaluation of that particular 3-case approach to a “language of care”, considered within broader hypothesis space (e.g. the set of all 1-, 2-, 3-, 4-.... case systems for relating with the “category of care”).  Then we can do inference within that hypothesis space, e.g. evaluate those different options with Bayesian Information Criterion, or Parsimony, or whatever implicit or explicit evaluative proceedure. To take that a bit further, the co-evolution of adaptive language (communicated cognitive frames/ways) makes sense in the Agent-Niche context, e.g. in an all-flat restaurant they might know “on”, while “on” might not matter for a restaurant only making milkshakes within orbs (they would know “[mixed] in/with” and “in” the container but there is nothing that can be “on” for them). The “cognitive turn” is this realization of agential multipolarity, what [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_su1nmfT1](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_su1nmfT1) called omnicentric, here with a structural-linguistic [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suli3zvK](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suli3zvK) prismatic expansion. 

There is the eating itself (the 1st person engagement). Then there is second-person cooking (preparing educational materials for others, “*But it seems, from the examples, that furthermore I can transfer that tuning, or construct a "virtual tuning", to another being. Which is to say, I can care first-hand but I can also care second-hand.*”. You write “*This means that I am able to rework my visceral tuning fork into a virtual tuning fork.*”, this is like being able to (communicate/transfer) having “good taste”. The meta-level of that, is going from a direct peer tutor (second-person) into indirect education where “*at the metalevel, we can consider ourselves and others like us*.”. That is like going from kitchen mentor, into starting up a (Language for a) Culinary Institute.

While “the dose makes the poison/medicine”: “taste” has a broad zone of biological acceptability (e.g. ruling out foods of extreme high or low temperature, or with toxic metals or microorganisms), and within that tolerable range there are Cultures with place and longevity (personal and shared humanities). For example  operates [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_sugFmpP_](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_sugFmpP_) as culinary training context for the [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_su618O5l](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_su618O5l) language of food. While [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_sueJ-FiS](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_sueJ-FiS) is part of [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suIBhimW](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suIBhimW), where the [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suMdl6PD](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suMdl6PD) cuisine is designed and enjoyed. 

Cultures (and Languages, Perspectives, etc...) are as similar as they are similar, and as different as they are different “only so, and not more” ([see footnote 11](https://blakequarterly.org/index.php/blake/article/view/rix494/rix494html))! 



2.

To address your questions “What questions do you want to investigate?  How are you investigating them?  Where are you sharing your work on that?”. 

1. What questions do you want to investigate?

   1. Personally, including in organizational positions/interfaces, for each project I engage in (even the seed/passive ones), I have the propositional description of the work (M1), the target questions (M2), and that double-vision or blend of the known and unknown (M3). So there are nested levels of questions/investigations, and I will share more about different aspects of this with M4W and individuals, in the time to come! 

      1. 

1. How are you investigating them?  

   1. Through Synchronous attention alone and together, leading to “changed minds” (belief updating) and “changed world” (stigmergic niche modification). 

   1. Synchronously I hope we find times to connect in [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_su0opxmi](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_su0opxmi), and Asynchronously through [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suSWQ4PS](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suSWQ4PS) and Email.

1. Where are you sharing your work on that?

   1. In the [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suV-LOe1](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suV-LOe1) document ([https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_su0opxmi](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_su0opxmi) are a good entry point), as well as the [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suCwO2Pw](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suCwO2Pw) on this mailing list. 

   1. There are other sources where I share public work like my website [https://cognitivesecurity.us/](https://cognitivesecurity.us/) and Telegram [http://t.me/docxology](http://t.me/docxology) . 

I look forward to reading/participating more via this list and privately. If you are interested in the above, [https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suKvOq4x](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suKvOq4x)! 

Peace & Bzzzzzzz for all ~

Daniel

From: **kirby urner** <kirby.urner@gmail.com>  
Date: Mon, Dec 8, 2025 at 12:31 PM

Cc: Ryan Buchanan <theryestbread@gmail.com>, Daniel Ari Friedman <danielarifriedman@gmail.com>  


Hello friends. I just gave this a first read through. 

Thank you for writing Andrius and including so many details about what’s going on with you. It’s all news to me. I have not been getting updates from Ryan to any degree of specificity so I am pleased to find out all of this infrastructure is in place. 

As to the three minds, you will see in the thread that I am turning enumeration over to you entirely in other words how to map Freud's three minds to your three minds is entirely up to you. I do know he used that nomenclature of super ego, ego, id. He was a moving target as are we all. 

As for AI output being slop I’ve started to use the word spiel in addition to slop, as I think it comes in many grades of value. I find the imagery in many ways more enticing than the text, although both have similar anomalous, hallucinatory, odd, freakish mutant qualities.

I am voice to text at the moment from the lobby of Fox Tower Regal Cinema where I am waiting for the new Russell Crowe movie to start. Nuremberg.

I have fun memories of coming to this part of town with Ryan and Andrius. I will upload some of the pictures later.

Andrius, I am glad you are putting the “24 ways” directly into your AI template as it always came across to me that this 24 was more or less a forgone conclusion given your approach. Given I’m a guy with philosophy training I find it important to recognize tautologies at work. One should not raise an eyebrow in the same way when things come true of a tautological nature; it’s not an empirical matter. I think much of what we call absolute truth is of a tautological nature. I think much of what people argue about in philosophy is more of a definition than empirical nature. This leads to confusion. Frankenstein’s (ha ha, that was AI) Wittgenstein’s investigations were about clearing up such issues. I agree that “investigation” is the key. Philosophy of language was a huge advance over the theologically polluted claptrap we used to have to read.

My recollection is not that you faded out regarding the 24 ways because of lack of interest on the part of others, but because you yourself got bored thinking about Vladimir Putin. I in contrast am still focused on that war and think about little else some days. I think that’s why we went our separate ways. Here in Cascadia, we talk about the Alaska Accords. You can check it out if you ever want to pick up where we left off.



Kirby
